title: Complexes of finite Gorenstein flat and injective dimensions
summary: In this paper, we consider a Gorenstein-dimensional analogue of Foxby's characterization of Gorenstein rings. We prove that a commutative Noetherian local ring is Gorenstein if it admits a complex whose depth, Gorenstein flat dimension, and Gorenstein injective dimension are all finite. This gives an affirmative answer to the original question of Christensen, Foxby, and Holm, which had remained open in this generality even for modules, and at the same time establishes its natural extension to complexes.
